title: GLM (Z.ai)
description:
A component that connects to Zhipu AI's GLM large language models for 
advanced natural language processing. The GLM-5 generation are hybrid-reasoning 
MoE models with configurable thinking modes, strong agentic and coding 
performance, and up to a 1M-token context window: GLM-5.2 for frontier 
long-context reasoning, GLM-5 Turbo for a fast cost-effective tier, and the 
open-weight GLM-4.5 Air for efficient self-hosted workloads. Models are served 
through the OpenAI-compatible Z.ai cloud API (api.z.ai); self-hosted vLLM or 
SGLang deployments connect through the Custom Model profile.
